title: Quick Turkish Olives Stew
description: A fragrant one-pot stew bursting with herbs and the brine of black olives, perfect for a speedy dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a lacquerware bowl over medium heat.
Add diced onion, minced garlic, sliced carrot, and diced bell pepper, sautéing until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in 1 cup diced tomatoes, 2 cups chicken broth, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1 teaspoon dried thyme, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and add 1 cup pitted black olives, allowing the stew to gently simmer for 15 minutes to meld flavors.
Sprinkle in 1 teaspoon lemon zest and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt or pepper if needed.
Remove from heat and let the stew sit for 2 minutes to thicken slightly.
Serve hot as a hearty lunch or dinner, optionally garnished with fresh parsley or extra lemon zest.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
